title: A multiplayer game I made with Unity , and MCPs
author: MoonBeamofEast
selftext: I used Claude and codex along with Unity to build a multiplayer game, though not all features are not visible in this demo but just wanted to put teaser out there

comments.body: I don't really play games like this but this looks pretty cool.

replies.author: MoonBeamofEast
replies.body:
6 months, first it was copy pasting the code and experimenting but my speed pickedup when I used MCP's.   
  
For the environment I used Gaia a unity software to build the world. The environment is barely 10% of my systems can achieve more to come.
